description: This file defines the StorageConfig data class used for managing storage location configurations, along with extension functions to convert Uri objects into user-friendly strings in an Android context.

classes.name: StorageConfig
classes.description: A data class representing the storage location Uri, with a companion object providing a method to retrieve the storage location from preferences.

methods.name: storageLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location configuration as a Flow of StorageConfig objects by fetching and converting stored encrypted string preferences.

methods.name: toFriendlyString
methods.description: An extension function on Uri that returns a user-friendly string representation of the Uri, including the provider name and directory name.
